interpretation.raw_utf8: Decode this JSON string, then encode as UTF-8 without adding bytes. It contains the complete wire input, including exact CR/LF framing.
interpretation.network_chunks_utf8: When present, supply the UTF-8 encoding of each array item as one network read. This can affect malformed legacy-v4 behavior.
interpretation.network_chunks_base64: When present, base64-decode each item and supply it as one read. This represents splits inside UTF-8 code points.
interpretation.default_network_partition: If neither network chunk field is present, deliver raw_utf8 as one network read.
interpretation.ESTABLISHED: Observed behavior of the cited published upstream package. Malformed-input examples need not be protocol-conforming; their decoder behavior is established.
interpretation.HYPOTHESIS: Proposed recovery policy with an explicit expected result. It is not claimed as an upstream requirement.
interpretation.expected: foldedMessage is the profile-specific cumulative assistant-message projection; sidecars hold hook/run/transport observations, not additional standard wire fields.
interpretation.null_message: No snapshot was yielded before the decoder failed, where that oracle uses null.
interpretation.scope: No Rust port or live production backend was supplied or tested. These are reusable input/oracle cases, not a claim of conformance for the user implementation.

profiles.ai-sdk-ui7: Published ai@7.0.166. Every fixture starts from initialMessage or {id:"m",role:"assistant",parts:[]}. Expected foldedMessage is last readUIMessageStream snapshot, with JSON serialization omitting undefined. sidecars describe observed finish/abort/transient events and normalized onError callbacks; they are not UIMessage properties. The default read helper continues after an explicit error chunk; useChat has a throwing error policy. Unless network_chunks_base64 is present, raw_utf8 is supplied in one network read. Encoded escapes in raw_utf8 denote literal UTF-8 bytes after JSON decoding.
profiles.ai-sdk-v4: AI SDK ai@4.3.19 / @ai-sdk/ui-utils 1.2.11 source fold; generated id/date/revision omitted, NaN usage serialized as null. Inputs use each network_chunks_utf8 item as one read; errors can depend on batching because source parses an entire buffered read before callbacks. Executed against the published @ai-sdk/ui-utils@1.2.11 package via its exported callChatApi, supplying an in-memory Response through fetch; no parser shim.
profiles.assistant-stream-native-and-legacy: Exact assistant-stream AssistantMessage projection: omit deprecated content alias and every timing field. Expected message is last yielded message before EOF or error; null means no message yielded.
profiles.assistant-stream-ui-adapter: Published assistant-stream@0.3.56 UIMessageStreamDecoder -> AssistantMessageAccumulator. Removes deprecated content alias and nondeterministic timing. These are differential cases, not canonical AI SDK UIMessage expectations.
profiles.rust-preserving-recovery-v1: Proposed normalized assistant shape with stable text IDs, parts, and explicit incomplete states. Transport completion/errors/opaque events remain sidecars. These cases are policies for adoption or revision, not package behavior.
